## The TikTok Shop Affiliate Program: Driving Sales Through Creators


### How the Affiliate Program Works: For Brands and Creators


The TikTok Shop affiliate program connects sellers with creators who can feature eligible products in shoppable videos or LIVE streams. Sellers set commission terms and make products available; creators choose products, publish content, and earn commission on qualifying sales attributed to their promotion. This gives sellers access to creator-led product discovery without requiring the brand to produce every piece of content. Creators need access to affiliate features and must meet TikTok Shop’s current eligibility rules before tagging products. Check current requirements in the platform before planning a campaign.


### Open Collaboration vs. Target Collaboration: Strategic Campaign Setup


Open collaboration lets eligible creators discover and request to promote products listed in your campaign. It can broaden creator reach, but your team needs a process for reviewing requests and monitoring sample demand. Target collaboration lets you invite selected creators directly, giving you more control over who receives an offer and which products they see. Use it when audience fit, content style, or category knowledge matters more than volume. The FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform can support creator and product research. Assess each partner’s audience relevance and content quality before proceeding.


### Setting Profitable Commission Rates and Managing Creator Samples


Set commission with unit economics in view. Start with the margin remaining after product cost, platform fees, shipping, discounts, and expected returns. Decide what share can go to creator commission while preserving contribution margin. Include sample costs in the calculation: product, packing, shipping, and staff time count even when a sample does not lead to a post or sale. Define sample criteria, track dispatch and delivery, and follow up with a reasonable content timeline. Do not send repeated free inventory to creators who have not completed prior commitments.


### Best Practices for Creator Outreach and Relationship Management


Make outreach specific. Explain why the product suits the creator’s audience, identify the campaign objective, state commission and sample terms, and share approved product facts without scripting the creator’s voice. Record invitations, responses, sample status, published content, and agreed deliverables. Set expectations for accurate claims and product tagging, and provide a contact for questions. A reliable process reduces creator fatigue and helps identify partners who communicate clearly and deliver useful content.


### Tracking Affiliate Performance and Maximizing ROI


Review attributed orders, gross merchandise value (GMV), commission expense, sample cost, refunds, and contribution margin together. Views and clicks can indicate interest, but do not establish profitability. Compare results by creator, product, and content format over a consistent period, then adjust offers based on the full sales picture. Use the **FastMoss TikTok Data Analytics Platform** as a research aid for evaluating TikTok activity, while relying on Seller Center reporting and order records to reconcile attributed sales. Tie campaign decisions to shop data rather than attention alone.
